mapper.select: SELECT a.accommodation_no, a.accommodation_name, a.accommodation_address, a.accommodation_contents, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkin AS checkinTime, a.checkout AS checkoutTime, a.tel, a.keyword_no, a.business_no, a.category_no FROM accommodation a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_no = c.category_no LEFT JOIN keyword k ON a.keyword_no = k.keyword_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation (accommodation_name, accommodation_address, tel, checkin, checkout, accommodation_contents, category_no, keyword_no ) VALUES (#{acmName}, #{acmAddress}, #{acmTel}, #{checkinTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{contents}, #{category_no}, #{keyword_no} )
